verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature lets users describe a recurring job in plain language and trigger it on a schedule or event (docs-11, docs-36), and Linear Agent can chain multi-step actions (investigate, code, test, screenshot) without coding (docs-16, docs-25, docs-45, docs-62). However, this is agent/prompt-driven automation rather than a dedicated visual multi-step workflow builder, so PM-level control over complex branching logic isn't clearly evidenced.
